SELECT p.id AS article_id, p.title AS title, p.introduction AS introduction, ui.image AS image, p.author_id AS author_id, ui.user_name AS author_name, IFNULL(bc.browse_count, 0) AS browse_count, IFNULL(lc.like_count, 0) AS like_count, IFNULL(cc.collect_count, 0) AS collect_count, IFNULL(cm.comment_count, 0) AS comment_count, ( IFNULL(bc.browse_count, 0) * 0.1 + IFNULL(lc.like_count, 0) * 0.3 + IFNULL(cc.collect_count, 0) * 0.2 + IFNULL(cm.comment_count, 0) * 0.4 ) AS total_score FROM posts p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS browse_count FROM browse WHERE type = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) bc ON p.id = bc.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id AS post_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM likes WHERE type = 0 AND status = 0 GROUP BY target_id ) lc ON p.id = lc.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS collect_count FROM collect WHERE status = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) cc ON p.id = cc.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM comments WHERE type = 0 AND status = 0 AND parent_id = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) cm ON p.id = cm.post_id LEFT JOIN user_info ui ON p.author_id = ui.user_id WHERE p.status = 2 AND p.type = 0 AND p.post_type = 0 ORDER BY total_score DESC, p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

select p.id as id, p.author_id as author_id, ui.user_name as author_name, ui.exp as exp, p.title as title, p.introduction as introduction, pc.content as content, p.status as status, p.type as type, p.post_type as post_type, p.is_vip as is_vip, p.category_id as category_id, p.create_time as create_time, p.update_time as update_time, IFNULL(browse_count.browse_count, 0) AS view_count, IFNULL(like_count.like_count, 0) AS like_count, IFNULL(collect_count.collect_count, 0) AS collect_count, COALESCE(comment_count.comment_count, 0) as comment_count from posts p left join posts_content pc on p.content_id = pc.id left join user_info ui on p.author_id = ui.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS browse_count FROM browse WHERE type = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) browse_count ON p.id = browse_count.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT target_id AS post_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM likes WHERE type = 0 AND status = 0 GROUP BY target_id ) like_count ON p.id = like_count.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS collect_count FROM collect WHERE status = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) collect_count ON p.id = collect_count.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id AS post_id, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM comments WHERE type = 0 AND status = 0 GROUP BY post_id ) comment_count ON p.id = comment_count.post_id where p.id = #{id}
